name: Andrew Wampler
role: Vice President, Operational Excellence, Ballad Health
bio:
Andrew Wampler joined Mountain States Health Alliance (MSHA) in 2001 and currently serves as Vice President of Corporate Finance & VOS. As the Vice President of Finance, Andrew is responsible for fiscal reporting, budget planning, capital planning and growth initiatives. He works closely with the senior leadership team and other as part of the financial management team towards the fulfillment of the mission, values and strategic direction of MSHA. Andrew is also responsible for the VOS and lean implementation for the integrated healthcare system delivery of 13 hospitals, 21 primary care centers and numerous outpatient care sites. Andrew has 13 years of healthcare experience working with process improvement and financial analysis.

Andrew holds a BA and MBA from East Tennessee State University in Johnson City, TN. Andrew is on numerous committees, boards, and has been featured in several publications regarding the success of lean implementation at MSHA. Andrew is a Certified Healthcare Financial Professional and is involved in a wide range of programs involving business and fiscal affairs of MSHA.
